Overview.Name: R Mamatha
Overview.Goal: Improve energy levels, support hormonal balance, reduce health risks, and improve mental wellbeing with simple, sustainable meals.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 whole eggs pan fried + cooked vegetables
OR Egg omelette with onions and tomatoes
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry + 1 cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish pan fried + rice + vegetable curry
Meal_3_Dinner: OR Egg omelette (3 eggs) + vegetable plate

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on eggs, chicken, and fish regularly to support hormonal balance and fat loss.
Keep meals simple and home cooked to avoid overeating.
Since PCOS is present, avoid refined snacks and sugary foods.
If boredom triggers eating, keep fixed meal timings and avoid grazing.
Prepare vegetables and boil eggs in advance to reduce effort.
Increase daily movement gradually even outside yoga sessions.
Drink enough water through the day to support digestion and hormones.
